_comment: CC-SNAP-BOXES F4 / I-B6 — the ONE source for every gap threshold in the From a photo pipeline. Each is a multiple of the line's median glyph width. Rust bakes this in with include_str!; the Swift plugin mirrors it and scripts/snap-geometry-check.mjs fails the build if they drift. Change a number here, nowhere else.
_column_gap: CC-SNAP-LAYOUT 2.1 — a gutter between two columns, in the same units as the rest of this file (multiples of the line's median glyph width). Far larger than split_gap because a column gutter is nothing like a dropped space. PROVISIONAL: the 15-page Level 2 fixture that would calibrate it does not exist, and snap_layout refuses to detect anything while LayoutConfig::baked() is disabled.
